reason: It's a brand-new brand with no reviews I can see and no lab results, just a creator pushing a code. I'm not putting $68 down and signing up for a filter subscription on a vibe.
objection: How do I know the filter actually does anything? Nothing here says what it removes or shows independent testing, and 'the supplier rates it' isn't proof.
would_change_my_mind: Published third-party lab test results (e.g. NSF certification) showing what the filter removes, plus a few hundred real verified reviews.
